title: The Most Entitled 12 Year Old Ever (Police Bodycam)
description:
The police officer explicitly mentioned in the incident report that "I NOTICED SHE WAS UNUSUALLY LARGE FOR A 12 YEARS OLD. SHE WAS THE SIZE OF AN ADULT." So we understand if you have a hard time believing she's 12 but she actually is.

On April 7th, 2022, an officer responded to a runaway report. Upon contacting the parents of the female, the officer learned that she had left home to go to her friend’s house but departed without informing them of her whereabouts. Later, they were able to locate her, but she was very uncooperative. Shortly after, they were able to locate the daughter, who was behaving very aggressively. The situation continued to escalate because the daughter wasn’t eager to understand the situation and remain calm. The female continued yelling and behaving in an agitated manner. The female was showing no signs of calming down and continued to disobey the officers. Because of her attitude, the officers had no choice but to put her in shackles. Even after being shackled, the female didn’t stop abusing the officers. Shortly after, the officers decided to wrap her up in restraints. She was soon transported to jail for further processing. The female was charged with battery upon a peace officer, assault on a peace officer and resisting arrest

About Us / Disclaimer: 

Police Insider provides unbiased and authentic footage of incidents captured on body cams. We believe this footage can be used as an educational guide for viewers. 

We only provide unique and original content that hasn’t been covered before on YouTube.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
